# Level-Up Hair Salon

> Family-owned unisex hair salon in Rancho Park, Los Angeles. Haircuts, cut and colour, blow-drys and styling, perms and chemical treatments for women, men and kids.

- Address: 10962 W Pico Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90064
- Hours: Monday to Wednesday 9am to 6pm, Thursday and Friday 9am to 7pm, Saturday 9am to 6pm, closed Sunday
- Book: request an appointment on the homepage form
- Reviews: https://www.yelp.com/biz/level-up-hair-salon-los-angeles
